name: health-indicator
title: Health Indicator
description: How work is going, as its latest update set it: a glyph and its words for On track, At risk, Off track and No update; never a fill.

meta.whenToUse: The health of an initiative or project in a row, a side panel's details or a timeline's leading slot.
meta.whenNotToUse: A task's workflow status (StatusIcon), a run step's state (StatusGlyph), or a request's lifecycle (RequestStatusChip).
